summary.plain: An underground physics laboratory under Mount Tobazo in the Spanish Pyrenees, reached via a former railway tunnel near the village of Canfranc.
summary.technical: Underground hall beneath Mount Tobazo, Canfranc-Estacion, Huesca, at ~800 m depth, excavated from the disused Somport (Canfranc) railway tunnel near the France-Spain border.
